statement.p: Find the following for the function y=6\sin \left(9x-4\right)+6
(a) What is the period of y=6\sin \left(9x-4\right)+6 \text{?}
(b) What is the amplitude of y=6\sin \left(9x-4\right)+6 \text{?}
(c) What is the phase shift of y=6\sin \left(9x-4\right)+6 \text{?} (Use a positive number for a shift to the right, and negative for to the left.)
